o.text: From Proto-Turkic *sārïg (“yellow, white”). Cognate with Bashkir һары (harı), Chuvash шурӑ (šură), Old Turkic 𐰽𐰺𐰍 (sarïɣ), Turkish sarı.
From Arabic تَأَثُرَات (taʔaṯurāt), plural of تَأَثُّر (taʔaṯṯur).
